newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Danish Chr.Hansen H1 96/97 seen 14 pct up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Danish Chr.Hansen H1 96/97 seen 14 pct up.

text.p: Five analysts polled by Reuters in a survey issued on Thursday forecast an average first-half 1996/97 profit before tax and extraordinary items for Danish biotechnology company Chr. Hansen of 162 million crowns.
The estimates ranged from 150-180 million crowns. The forecast was a 14 percent improvement on profit of 142 million crowns in the same period in 1995-96.
Turnover for the first six months of 1996/97 was seen 17 percent higher at an average 1.218 billion crowns, with estimates in the 1.176-1.300 billion crown range.
Chr. Hansen announces its first-half 1996/97 results on Monday April 28. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
